title: Near-Optimal Regret Bounds for UCB-Style Gaussian Process Bandits via Data Thinning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28136v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gaussian process upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) has been widely studied, though its known regret upper bound is suboptimal. To obtain near-optimal regret upper bounds, existing studies mainly focus on non-adaptive methods, such as uncertainty sampling, whose practical effectiveness is often limited. This paper shows that, under a Gaussian noise assumption, UCB-style algorithms can achieve near-optimal regret upper bounds via data thinning, a statistical technique for creating independent datasets from a single dataset. First, we show that data thinning can yield tighter confidence intervals in the bandit setting, and that a direct extension of GP-UCB achieves a near-optimal simple regret upper bound. Furthermore, by leveraging the tighter confidence intervals and combining GP-UCB with a phased elimination algorithm, we show a near-optimal cumulative regret upper bound. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of UCB-style algorithms

translated_title: 通过数据拆分技术实现UCB式高斯过程赌博机的近最优遗憾界
translated_abstract: 高斯过程置信上界算法已被广泛研究，但其已知的遗憾上界是次优的。为了获得近最优的遗憾上界，现有研究主要集中于非自适应方法，例如不确定性采样，但其实际效果往往有限。本文表明，在高斯噪声假设下，UCB式算法可以通过数据拆分——一种从单个数据集创建独立数据集的统计技术——实现近最优的遗憾上界。首先，我们证明数据拆分可以在赌博机设置中产生更紧的置信区间，并且GP-UCB的直接扩展可以实现近最优的简单遗憾上界。此外，通过利用更紧的置信区间并将GP-UCB与分阶段消除算法相结合，我们证明了近最优的累积遗憾上界。最后，我们展示了UCB式算法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出在高斯噪声假设下，通过数据拆分技术使UCB式高斯过程赌博机算法获得更紧的置信区间，从而实现近最优的简单遗憾和累积遗憾上界。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that, under Gaussian noise assumptions, UCB-style Gaussian process bandit algorithms can achieve near-optimal simple and cumulative regret bounds via data thinning, which yields tighter confidence intervals.
